description: Keyword search over POLISH government tender notices — Poland public procurement / zamówienia publiczne — published in the Biuletyn Zamówień Publicznych via the official e-Zamówienia platform (ezamowienia.gov.pl, Urząd Zamówień Publicznych). Case-insensitive match against the notice title/order object (przedmiot zamówienia), contracting authority name (zamawiający), and CPV classification codes, within a publish-date window. Use POLISH keywords for best recall (e.g. "szpital", "roboty budowlane", "oprogramowanie", "Warszawa") since titles and buyer names are in Polish; a CPV code or prefix (e.g. "45", "72000000") also matches. Returns compact shaped notices with buyer, order type, CPV codes, submission deadline, and notice URL.

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 2 days before date_to. The call fetches day-by-day, newest first, and stops once "limit" matches are found or 7 day(s) have been scanned (whichever comes first).

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Max matching notices to return (default 20, max 100).

query.description: Keyword(s), case-insensitive substring match against title, buyer name, or CPV codes. Polish terms match best ("roboty", "usługi sprzątania", "Urząd Miasta"); a CPV code or prefix ("45", "72000000") matches classification codes.

name: pl_tender_search
title: Pl Tender Search
